page.overview:
Who is Battista Gaspar Necrodomo?

Battista Gaspar Necrodomo, known to history as "Necrodomo the Insane", was a Tilean mystic from the province of Remas known as a heretic scryer, seer and astromancer whose writings inspired the fall to Chaos of the templar Diederick Kastner, who became Archaon, the thirteenth and final Everchosen of Chaos Undivided.

Necrodomo used the stars, their relative positions and the patterns they cast across the night sky to make predictions about times that were to come.

He was the author of several heretical texts: Signs and Wonders, Transcendentia, The Days of Doom to Come, The End Times and The Liber Caelestior, also known as the Celestine Book of Divination, and the Necrodomo Codex; this last book is considered especially dangerous since it prophesises the coming of the End Times so the Grand Theogonist of the Cult of Sigmar forbid even his Sigmarite priests to read it, even if some pages had been torn from the tome.

In the Necrodomo Codex Necrodomo set out to reveal what he claimed were the hidden truths of the mortal world, identifying the events that led to the collapse of the Chaos Gates and the doom that now hung over the Known World because of it. A prophet and seer of extraordinary ability, Necrodomo was said to foresee future events with uncanny precision, a gift that became a curse, for he claimed to have perceived the true nature of Chaos in all its infinite complexity.
